description: This file implements a webhook-based converter for CustomResourceDefinitions (CRDs) in Kubernetes, handling conversion requests and responses, validation, and metadata restoration.

classes.name: webhookConverterFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating webhook converters for CRDs.

classes.name: webhookConverter
classes.description: Per-CRD converter that calls external webhooks for object conversion.

methods.name: newWebhookConverterFactory
methods.description: Creates a new webhookConverterFactory with provided service and auth resolvers.

methods.name: WebhookClientConfigForCRD
methods.description: Generates webhook client configuration from CRD spec.

methods.name: NewWebhookConverter
methods.description: Creates a new webhookConverter for a specific CRD.

methods.name: getObjectsToConvert
methods.description: Returns list of objects needing conversion based on version mismatch.

methods.name: createConversionReviewObjects
methods.description: Creates conversion review request and response objects for supported versions.

methods.name: getConvertedObjectsFromResponse
methods.description: Validates and extracts converted objects from webhook response.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Performs object conversion via webhook call, handling list and single objects, validation, and metadata restoration.

methods.name: validateConvertedObject
methods.description: Checks that object metadata (kind, name, namespace, UID) matches between original and converted.

methods.name: restoreObjectMeta
methods.description: Copies metadata from original to converted object, preserving labels and annotations.

methods.name: isEmptyUnstructuredObject
methods.description: Checks if an unstructured object is empty (only apiVersion and kind).
